explication: Defyx VPN is a Flutter VPN client. The principal workflow is user interaction with the Flutter UI, platform-channel dispatch, native VPN orchestration, and DXcore tunnel startup, producing protected internet access and connection status. Android and Apple platforms use native VPN services and packet-tunnel providers; Linux and Windows add desktop channel handlers, system-proxy integration, tray behavior, and persistent preferences. The Flutter/Dart sources and several native implementations were not included, so those links are limited to documented capabilities and sampled entry points.
